properties.Description: Non-Core MAP schema for first-class Visualizer Holons, their executable realizations, and type-based applicability. Capability taxonomies, compatibility/release contracts, Visualizer Commons stewardship, and dynamic acquisition are deliberately deferred.

Transient response-body projection containing an opaque handle to one Rust-authorized executable realization of a selected Visualizer Holon. The module source remains in the artifact backend and is retrieved through the artifact command boundary.
Dance response wrapping a transient MaterializedVisualizer projection.
Visualizer-afforded dance that retrieves one executable realization without making frontend caches an authority.
properties.DanceDescription: Materializes executable code for one selected Visualizer Holon through the Rust-owned artifact backend.

properties.Description: Meta-type for Visualizer Holon Type descriptors. It identifies the descriptor family whose instances are DAHN Visualizer Holons and provides a semantic target for Visualizer-role composition and discovery.

Abstract family anchor for DAHN Visualizer Holon Types. Ordinary Visualizer Holons must be described by concrete descendants; their semantic identity is distinct from executable implementation identities. A Visualizer defines its semantic Slots and owns the presentation strategy that dynamically composes them within the allocation supplied by its parent.
A coherent experience container bound to one MetaDesignSystem. It may contain only Visualizers that support that system.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that compose a canvas experience.

properties.VisualizerDescription: Uses the application’s standard canvas shell to host the experience you open.
Uses a titled card with an action bar, name-and-value rows, a side rail for single connections, and tabs for related collections. Sections can be expanded to give them more room.
Places single connections above the detail fields in an expanded card. Keeps the action bar and related collection tabs, with the same compression and navigation controls.

properties.VisualizerSlotDescription: Show the details recorded for this item.
Show the actions available for this item and provide access to them.
Present a group of related items so you can examine its members and open an item.
Inspect the item reached through a connection that has a single destination.
Show the details recorded for this item.
Show the actions available for this item and provide access to them.
Present a group of related items so you can examine its members and open an item.
Inspect the item reached through a connection that has a single destination.

properties.VisualizerDescription: Arranges actions as buttons in a horizontal bar. Actions that do not fit are collected in a More actions menu.

properties.Description: Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that represent individual holons.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that realize a multi-Holon semantic structure organized by a topology.
Structure Visualizer subkind for interaction-derived navigation rooted at one Holon.

properties.VisualizerDescription: Arranges item cards along the path you explore. Single connections extend to the right; opening an item from a collection extends downward. Earlier steps stay in view, with pan and zoom controls for longer paths.

properties.VisualizerSlotDescription: Show an item’s details, provide access to its actions, and let you explore its connections.

properties.Description: Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that represent holon collections.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that represent a set of Properties within one presentation strategy.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that compose one descriptor-defined property name with a selected Value Visualizer. It does not own set-level layout.

properties.VisualizerDescription: Stacks the item’s properties in a scrollable list, with a divider between rows and a cue when more details are below.

properties.VisualizerSlotDescription: Identify one property and present its value.

properties.VisualizerDescription: Places the property name on the left and its value on the right. Long text wraps within its column.

properties.VisualizerSlotDescription: Present this property’s value in a form suited to its value type.

properties.Description: Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that represent values.

properties.VisualizerDescription: Displays the stored string as plain, read-only text.
Displays the stored whole number as read-only text, including zero and negative values.
Displays the words true and false as read-only text.
Displays the stored option as read-only text.
Displays a compact byte-count summary, such as [32 bytes].

properties.Description: Composes contextual actions into uniformly allocated slots and groups.

properties.VisualizerSlotDescription: Identify an available action and provide a way to invoke it when supported.

properties.VisualizerDescription: Displays the action’s name on a disabled button, with an explanation that its interaction is unavailable.
Uses a labeled button to select data from your computer, then opens a load-results view where you can review progress, problems, and saved items.

properties.VisualizerSlotDescription: Present the problems and validation findings from a data load so you can review what needs attention.
Present the items saved by a data load so you can examine them and open an item.

properties.Description: Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that represent actions.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that represent graph-oriented views.

Concrete semantic identity for one executable realization of a Visualizer Holon. Its runtime and stable implementation key support static resolution without making a client registry semantic authority. Acquisition, compatibility, and implementation-private behavior are deferred.

Semantic role within a Visualizer's composition that declares one or more accepted Visualizer Holon Type roles. It does not encode runtime occupancy or spatial geometry. Retained usage associations record successful presentations; descriptor-specific preference records identify remembered choices.

The local space agent's use and personalized configuration of a selected Visualizer for one subject descriptor. Preparation alone does not record successful use. Empty override relationships preserve neutral default presentation.
Relates a Visualizer Holon to one or more executable realization identities without making any realization the Visualizer's durable semantic identity.
Inverse of ImplementedBy. Each first-cut VisualizerImplementation realizes exactly one Visualizer Holon.

Declares a descriptor Type against which a selector evaluates a Visualizer Holon's applicability using its type lineage. Node and Properties visualizers target HolonType lineages; Property and Value visualizers may target PropertyType and ValueType lineages.
Inverse of ApplicableToType, exposing the Visualizer Holons applicable to a descriptor Type.
Declares the semantic VisualizerSlots that a Visualizer requires for its internal composition.
Inverse of HasSlot. Each first-cut VisualizerSlot belongs to exactly one Visualizer.

Declares one or more Visualizer Holon Type roles accepted by a semantic Slot. Its cardinality applies to accepted role declarations, not runtime occupancy; contract fulfillment belongs to the selected Visualizer; usage anchors configuration and successful-choice associations.
Inverse of AcceptsVisualizerType, exposing the semantic slots that accept a Visualizer Holon Type role.
Identifies the shared Visualizer capability used by one context-owned VisualizerUsage.
Inverse of UsesVisualizer, exposing context-owned usages of a shared Visualizer.
Records successful presentation of this usage at a slot; the selected Visualizer, not usage, fulfills the slot contract.
Inverse of SelectedForSlot, exposing retained successful usages selected at this slot.
Runtime in which a VisualizerImplementation is executable; the initial runtime set is intentionally small and extensible.
Stable symbolic key by which a statically bundled runtime may resolve a VisualizerImplementation to executable code.
Opaque, host-scoped artifact capability returned by MaterializeVisualizer. It is not a filesystem path, URL, or content identifier and is valid only at the artifact command boundary.
Content digest for the executable artifact of a VisualizerImplementation. The value is encoded as algorithm:hex and is verified by the host artifact backend before issuing a handle.
Executable module format declared by a VisualizerImplementation and returned with its materialized artifact handle.
Initial execution runtime variants supported by VisualizerImplementation identities; future runtime variants may be added without changing semantic Visualizer identity.
A TypeScript implementation bundled with a DAHN client.
A Rust implementation available to the MAP host runtime.
Binds a Canvas to the one MetaDesignSystem that governs all contained Visualizers and Theme selection.
Inverse of UsesMetaDesignSystem.
Contains a Visualizer whose supported MetaDesignSystems include the Canvas's one UsesMetaDesignSystem target.
Inverse of ContainsVisualizer.
Declares the small semantic set of DesignTokens a Visualizer consumes.
Inverse of ConsumesDesignToken.

properties.VisualizerDescription: Groups load-result details above tabbed result collections, with a side rail for related items. The title bar supports the same exploration and expansion controls as Holon Inspector.

properties.VisualizerSlotDescription: Explain the outcome of this data load, including its status and result counts.
Provide access to the actions available for this load result.
Present a group of items related to this load result so you can examine them and open an item.

properties.Description: Optional human-readable explanation of how a Visualizer fulfills a slot's purpose, including its presentation approach and distinguishing behavior.
Optional human-readable explanation of the task and purpose of a Visualizer slot, independent of the presentation approach selected to fulfill it.
Remembered explicit choice after successful presentation, scoped to one slot and subject descriptor. Separate from retained usages and exploratory choices.
ForSubjectType association for agent-relative Visualizer usage and preference.
Inverse of ForSubjectType.
Extension point for explicit personalized PropertySalience overrides. No instances or editing/score model are required for neutral initialization.
PropertySalienceOverrides association for agent-relative Visualizer usage and preference.
Inverse of PropertySalienceOverrides.
Extension point for explicit personalized RelationshipSalience overrides. No instances or editing/score model are required for neutral initialization.
RelationshipSalienceOverrides association for agent-relative Visualizer usage and preference.
Inverse of RelationshipSalienceOverrides.
Extension point for explicit personalized ActionSalience overrides. No instances or editing/score model are required for neutral initialization.
ActionSalienceOverrides association for agent-relative Visualizer usage and preference.
Inverse of ActionSalienceOverrides.
Extension point for explicit personalized ActionGroup overrides. No instances or editing/score model are required for neutral initialization.
ActionGroupOverrides association for agent-relative Visualizer usage and preference.
Inverse of ActionGroupOverrides.
PreferenceForSlot association for agent-relative Visualizer usage and preference.
Inverse of PreferenceForSlot.
PreferenceForSubjectType association for agent-relative Visualizer usage and preference.
Inverse of PreferenceForSubjectType.
PreferredUsage association for agent-relative Visualizer usage and preference.
Inverse of PreferredUsage.
